result.title: Supervaluationism about vagueness and indeterminacy: A judgment-aggregation perspective
result.summary: Supervaluationism about vagueness and indeterminacy is based on the idea that some sentences, or predicates within them, have multiple competing interpretations or specifications. A sentence is deemed determinately true if and only if it is true according to all specifications; and determinately false if and only if it is false according to all specifications. In all other cases, the sentence is assigned no determinate truth-value. Supervaluationism, however, is only one way of taking into account the verdicts of different specifications -- in technical terms, "aggregating" those verdicts. In this paper, we introduce insights from the theory of judgment aggregation to study a broad class of different aggregation functions. This allows us to offer an axiomatic characterization of supervaluationism, which, in turn, locates it precisely within a larger logical space of possible approaches to vagueness and indeterminacy. Among other results, we axiomatically compare supervaluationism with subvaluationism, the epistemic theory of vagueness, and Strong Kleene and LP logics.

AI.brief_summary: 论文引入判断聚合理论，研究在多个相互竞争的解释或规范下汇总判定结果的一类聚合函数，并给出超赋值论的公理化刻画，进而与次赋值论、认知主义真理论及 Strong Kleene、LP 逻辑作公理化比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 「在所有规范下为真才算确定」这一聚合准则可能为多 latent 假设或多条推理轨迹的答案确定性、置信度与 STOP 决策提供概念框架，可供核查其公理区分是否能对应不同的证据筛选规则。
